fare.discounts: 10% off (9折) with Chengdu Metro App, Tianfutong App, Tianfu Citizen Cloud App, or Tianfutong card. 1-day pass ¥20, 3-day pass ¥50, 5-day pass ¥70 (per gochinaroute guide; verify). Tram Rong 2 is a flat ¥2 per ride, separate fare.
fare.formula: ¥2 for the first 4 km; +¥1 per 4 km from 4-12 km; +¥1 per 6 km from 12-24 km; +¥1 per 8 km from 24-40 km; +¥1 per 10 km from 40-50 km; +¥1 per 20 km above 50 km.
fare.note: Fare needs real OD distances between stations for the app's fare estimator. Line lengths above are end-to-end only. For other cities the app estimates fares; the same approach applies here - do NOT present band-table lookup as exact without OD distances.
fare.official_site_note: Official fare page on chengdurail.com could not be fetched from this environment; verify against the official site before shipping.
fare.rule: Distance-based (里程计价). Source: Bendibao fare page (reproduces official Chengdu Metro fare policy) + Trip.com fare table.

lines.notes: Phase 2 (Guilong Road - Shilidian, 6 stations; Lianhua - Longgang, 1 station) opened 2024-12-19. Older sources listing 25 stations / Lianhua-Shilidian termini are pre-phase-2 and STALE.

lines.name: 9号线
lines.notes: First fully automated GoA4 line in western China.

lines.name: 10号线
lines.notes: Phase 3 first section (Taipingyuan - Wuhou Shrine) opened 2025-09-17. Wenweng Shishi, People's Park and Luomashi stations are NOT yet open (see not_yet_open). Small/large routing: Wuhou Shrine - Xinping and Wuhou Shrine - Huaqiao.

lines.name: 13号线
lines.notes: Express line, GoA4 fully automated, 140 km/h, 8-car Type A. Single route Wayaotan - Long'an, ~43 min end to end.

lines.color_name: light green (mapa-metro calls it coral - hex from Wikipedia module is #87E0AA)
lines.name: 17号线
lines.notes: Phase 2 (Jitouqiao - Gaohong, 18 stations) opened 2025-09-17. Phase 1 was Jinxing - Jitouqiao; on 2023-09-22 the Jinxing - Jiujiang North section was split off as Line 19. Small/large routing: Jiujiang North - Gaohong and Jiujiang North - Jichechang.

lines.name: 18号线
lines.notes: Express line to Tianfu International Airport, 140 km/h, direct (express) trains South Railway Station - Tianfu Airport. Tianfu station is TRANSFER-ONLY (no entry/exit, paid area only). Jincheng Plaza (Line 1) and Jincheng Plaza East (Line 18) are separate stations requiring out-of-station transfer for now. Unopened: Tianfu Airport Terminals 3 & 4 station, Guanyan (see not_yet_open).

lines.name: 19号线
lines.notes: Express line, 160 km/h. Phase 1 (Jinxing - Jiujiang North) split from Line 17 on 2023-09-22; Phase 2 (Jiujiang North - Tianfu Station) opened 2023-11-28. Trains run through from Tianfu Station onto Line 18 tracks to Tianfu Airport North (shared service Sancha - Tianfu Airport North). Dual-airport direct trains run Shuangliu Airport - Tianfu Airport. Tianfu station is TRANSFER-ONLY (no entry/exit). Unopened: Hejiang (see not_yet_open).

timetable.note: Line 19 terminus is Tianfu Station, but timetables are published for the through service to Tianfu Airport North.

lines.name: 27号线
lines.notes: GoA4 fully automated. Bairendian station built but NOT open (see not_yet_open). Published '23 stations' counts the unopened Bairendian.

lines.name: 30号线
lines.notes: GoA4 fully automated. Yuhong Road and Fenshui stations built but NOT open (see not_yet_open). Published '24 stations' counts the two unopened stations. Out-of-station transfer (30 min, continuous fare) between Shuangliu Airport Terminal 2 East (Line 19/30) and Shuangliu Airport Terminal 2 (Line 10).

lines.name: S3线
lines.notes: Intercity line Chengdu-Ziyang, 160 km/h, 4-car Type A, ~26 min end to end. Same fare table as Chengdu Metro; full-line max fare 8 yuan. Lujia station built but NOT open (reserved station, see not_yet_open).

totals.interchange_note: 6 three-line + 73 two-line. The Line 1 main/branch junction Sihe is NOT counted in the official 79.
totals.operating_lines_note: 16 urban metro lines (1-10, 13, 17, 18, 19, 27, 30) + 1 intercity line S3 (Ziyang line). The T2 tram (Rong 2, 36 stops) is NOT counted as a metro line and is EXCLUDED.
totals.route_km_note: zh-Wikipedia line-table total (unique route-km, shared 18/19 section counted once). Sum of individual line lengths is ~716 km (en-Wikipedia total 721.3 km); zh-Wikipedia intro cites 718.945 km. Discrepancy = double-counting of the 18/19 shared section (Tianfu - Tianfu Airport North). Use 663.93 km as the headline figure.
totals.stations_unique_note: 449 line-stations minus 79 interchange stations counted twice/thrice (6 three-line + 73 two-line = 85 extra counts; 449-85=364). Matches zh-Wikipedia footnote ('如不重复计算则为364座'). Amap states 365 unique stations - off by one, likely the transfer-only Tianfu station counting; flagged as a discrepancy, 364 used.
